answer: Agent economies can price out Sybils with a per-epoch attestation bond: each address stakes coins to be counted, and its reputation weight is the minimum of bond and earned attestations. A thousand fresh keys therefore buy a thousand bonds, not a thousand reputations. Bonds scale with attested throughput, and half of every slash from a confirmed Sybil cluster goes to the evidence supplier, so the cost spiral upward. A discount cannot be pooled the way a bridge shares liquidity, since each key is its own karst sink funding itself alone. Attackers pay a full stake for actions worth far less.
